summary: Round 11, successor scenario (answer to the user's 17:00 UTC question). Nothing here is a new scoring mechanism for the current finals. The finals stay #37 + #38 unless a public successor appears. (a) Crowd arithmetic. The x138 block grows ~3.4/h (~80/day): 258 at 25 Sep 22:16Z -> 354 at 26 Sep 17:01Z. A successor seen at 27 Sep 00Z would draw ~150-280 copies by the deadline; seen at 28 Sep 12Z, ~60-120; at 29 Sep 06Z, ~30-70. A rank Monte Carlo (priors in the notes; calibrated to the 16:54 forecast: with no successor P(bronze) 0.73, P(silver) 0.12, median rank 326) gives, for a successor with own public 0.954/0.955/>=0.956 and ~150 copies: no action {#37,#38} P(bronze) 0.55/0.48/0.42; {verbatim port, #37} 0.84/0.89/0.93 if the port goes in early (only ~10% of copies ahead of it); {successor+insertion, #37} 0.80/0.83/0.87, with silver 0.31/0.41/0.51 against 0.21/0.29/0.40 for the port. {successor+insertion, port} drops #37 and falls to 0.52 when the successor's public margin is noise, so never use it. A late port (80% of copies ahead) falls to ~0.6 with 300 copies; successor+insertion does not depend on timing. (b) Feasibility is proven offline. The K2 patch set (divinsert + safetail + lowrefine) applies with every anchor matched exactly once and compiles on three x138-family notebooks: amanatar old, amanatar v10 and Harmonic Fusion V3. On all three the changed lines match, hunk for hunk, the x138 -> K2 change, and the insertion stays the last graph edit. The smallest builder change is a '--base succ' path locked to #37's exact recipe, with transplant-equality and structure checks, tests and FF/dummy gates. (c) Threshold: the successor's own displayed public score >= 0.954 (our best), for an x138-family notebook that passes the P3 hygiene clauses, P4b and P4c. At <= 0.953: do nothing. (d) E10 v2 rule text is drafted for ONE user OK. The successor+insertion part is valid only if its code, tests and a proxy dummy land before R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC); otherwise v2 keeps only the lower threshold and the port. Honest scale: P(an actionable successor by 29 Sep 06:00) is ~10-15%, so expected dP(bronze) is ~+0.03-0.05. With no successor (~85-90%), all of this has zero effect.

findings.what:
Crowd arithmetic and private rank per finals pair, if a public x138-family successor appears.
Copies:
- The x138 block grew ~80/day: 258 -> 354 between 25 Sep 22:16Z and 26 Sep 17:01Z.
- Expected copies by the deadline, by the time the successor appears: ~150-280 (26 Sep 22Z), ~120-220 (27 Sep 12Z), ~60-120 (28 Sep 12Z), ~30-70 (29 Sep 00Z).
Model:
- Exact copies tie on private at Y = X + g, ordered by submit time.
- Copiers keep max(own, Y).
- Medal lines: bronze 395, silver 197 of ~3,950.
Results, P(bronze) for own public 0.954 / 0.955 / 0.956 (150 copies, port early_frac 0.1):
- No action {#37,#38}: 0.55 / 0.48 / 0.42. With no successor it is 0.73.
- {port, #37}: 0.84 / 0.89 / 0.93.
- {SI = successor+K2 recipe, #37}: 0.80 / 0.83 / 0.87. P(silver) 0.31 / 0.41 / 0.51, against 0.21 / 0.29 / 0.40 for the port.
- {SI, port}: 0.71 / 0.82 / 0.89.
Lateness: a late port (80% of copies ahead) with 300 copies drops to 0.57-0.63; SI stays at 0.77-0.80.
Sensitivity:
- SI error 15% and insertion overlap rho ~ U(0,1): SI -0.04.
- Successor margin pure public noise (k = 0): P0 0.63, port 0.77, SI 0.76, {SI, port} 0.52.
Ranking of options (robust in every run): any action beats no action; never drop #37; the port is best for bronze only if it goes in early; SI is best for silver and robust to timing.
Caveat: part of the gain is a 'second ticket' effect. The successor's private gain is modelled independent of ours, and it replaces the twin, whose hedge is worth little (when delta < 0 the twin sits at or next to the ~350-copy x138 block, rank ~500+).

findings.what: Threshold: act when the successor's own displayed public score on its latest version is >= 0.954 (= #37). The current rule's 0.956 is R4's '+0.002 to adopt as better', but the successor file replaces only the twin (#38), and #37 stays in the pair, so no belief that the successor is better is needed. The decision is crowd defence plus a second ticket. Arithmetic (R11S-2): at 0.954, no action loses ~0.18 P(bronze) against the no-successor world (0.73 -> 0.55 with 150 copies), and either action restores ~0.80-0.84. At <= 0.953 the copies land at X, below #37 whenever delta > 0: do nothing. Keep every hygiene clause: P3 minus its score number, P4b, P4c, e10_port_gate PASS, x138 family only. A non-x138 or sweep/validator notebook means do nothing, even though its copies can still hurt us (say so honestly). 0.954 needs no 'clearly new mechanism' clause: the 1-2 explainable mechanisms clause of P3 already applies.

findings.what:
Smallest builder change for SI, and its gates. Everything must land before R8 (27 Sep 12:00 UTC), or SI is dropped and v2 is port-only.
BUILDER (tools/build_probe_kernel.py, ~120 lines):
(1) --base succ with --base-ipynb, --base-sha256 (the pulled file's sha, recorded in CONTEXT) and --base-meta.
(2) BASES['succ'] is built at run time: compact, cells config 2 / predict 4 / post 5, patches (divinsert, safetail, lowrefine). The x138-only checks become x138-or-succ.
(3) Recipe lock: the patch set must be exactly {divinsert, safetail, lowrefine} and the overrides exactly #37's dict (DIVINS_ENABLE 1, STEAL 1, CAP 4, FRAME_CAP 1, ALPHA 1, THRESH 0.4, DUMP 0, REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 34200, DIVINS_DEADLINE_S 28800, LOWREFINE_ENABLE 1, DEGRADE_KEEP_DIV 1). No --dataset. --lab only for FF.
(4) Refusals:
- sha mismatch;
- the markers 'def filter_output_graph(' / 'def write_test_submission' / the V1284 write_text mark / '_LOWDET: list = []' are not unique or not in cells 5 / 5 / 4 / 4;
- any anchor count != 1 (existing _rep1);
- the line after '# ---- /divinsert ----' is not the FINAL print;
- write_test_submission is not whitespace-normalised equal to x138 v1;
- the transplant hunks (difflib, per cell) or the new cells differ from x138 -> K2;
- kernel_sources != [] or a blank source.
(5) Metadata comes from --base-meta with P4b(a) sanitising (new id vitaliineibauer/biohub-exp67-si-<author>, private, internet off, no id_no; docker_image, machine_shape and sources kept) plus biohub-ft-weights.
TESTS:
- The --base x138 rebuilds keep sha exp58 1f1ddb6d, exp58t a77bcd6b and exp58n 55038fd6.
- --base succ on the exp56 notebook with the x138 sha and the K2 recipe gives notebook bytes == exp58 (1f1ddb6d).
- Builds on HF v3 and amanatar-old pass the transplant checks.
- amanatar v10 is refused (write_test_submission).
- Mutants are refused: duplicated linefit line, a stage between the call and FINAL, a changed write_test_submission, a moved cell, an extra --set, kernel_sources, a blank source.
- `python -m pytest -q tests` green (275 + new).
DUMMY GATES (dummy_gates.py --succ):
- G1: SI CSV valid (validate_csv, no duplicate (dataset, node_id), finite xyz).
- G2: 'SAFETAIL: repair deadline 34200s, divins deadline 28800s' present and none of K2's hard-fail lines.
- G3: LOWDET N per clip == PORT dummy; LOWREFINE R > 0, 0 failed.
- G4: raw nodes == PORT dummy; readmit and gapfill within +-10%.
- G5: a divinsert line on every clip; added > 0.
- G6: FF (SI recipe without lowrefine, --lab DIVINS_FORCE_FAIL=1) CSV sha256 == PORT dummy CSV, and 'DIVINS FAILED' on every clip.
- G7: SI dummy end - PORT dummy end <= 1.5 x (K2 dummy - exp56 dummy); forecast L(SI) = 6.46 h x (PORT dummy end / 1111.7 s) + 1.0 h <= 9.0 h.
PROXY DRY RUN before R8 (never submitted): PORT, SI and FF dummies of HF v3; G1-G7 must pass, or SI is not in force.
RUNTIME on the hidden run: SI ~= successor + <= 0.85 h insertion + 0.14 h lowrefine (K2 7.36-7.54 h against twin 6.69-6.87 h). The safetail deadlines are 9.5 h repair and 8.0 h insertion gate; the limit is 12 h.

(1) PORT's rank inside its copy block depends on detection latency: each hour of delay puts ~2-4 more copies ahead of us. The post-R8 P1 checks are every 6 h (27 Sep 12/18, 28 Sep 00/06/12/18, 29 Sep 00 UTC), and there is none at 29 Sep 06:00. Proposal: a check every 3 h from 27 Sep 12:00 to 29 Sep 06:00 UTC (read-only e10_snapshot, ~15 s each). SI does not depend on timing.
(2) The v1 last-submit time (29 Sep 02:00 UTC) was tied to R8, not to scoring. With a hidden runtime of ~7.5-8.5 h, the useful last submit is ~29 Sep 10:00 UTC (scored by ~19:00, ticks by 20:00).
(3) Unverified: whether Kaggle lets a PENDING submission be ticked. Assume not.
(4) The wake mechanism after R8 is still unanswered by the user (default: this session's own timers).
